label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user input from request.getParameter). Although the code validates param against a deploy-time regex (line 19), it does not perform HTML encoding before writing to the response (line 22). Raw user input written to the HTTP response without encoding is a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input retrieved at L16, validated at L19, and written to response at L22 without encoding.
